details: THE BULL by Italforni - the first pizza oven in the world entirely coated with coloured tempered glass.

The Italforni BLL "THE BULL" Tempered Stained Glass Large Electric Pizza Oven is an incredibly powerful and visually stunning centerpiece for any restaurant or premium catering establishment. Engineered from strong Italian steel and fully coated in coloured shock and high temperature resistant tempered glass, THE BULL is sure to make an impact and add wow factor with it's unique and characterful design.

Able to cook up to eight 30cm pizza at a time or hold three baking trays, each BLL pizza oven features a cooking chamber fully lined with refractory brick containing armoured “hy·pe” heating elements and offers a maximum cooking temperature of 450°C. The oven's outstanding thermal insulation ensures it's external temperature reaches a maximum of just 30°C while in use. Each oven deck has heavy duty counterbalanced doors with tempered double glazed glass windows and is lit internally by high resistance, high capacity halogen lighting. Operation is simple and easy thanks to the unit's intuitive TOUCH control board and digital display.

THE BULL is modular and fully customisable, with the ability to stack up to three pizza oven decks, a choice of proving unit bases or stands and of course the oven's signature hood. The oven comes in black or red as standard, but can be customised with any RAL colour and even personalised with your own unique designs to complement your restaurant's decor. Site surveys are available to help plan your installation - take a look at a kitchen refit project featuring the Italforni BULL Pizza Oven or call our sales team now to find out more.

details: THE BULL by Italforni - the first pizza oven in the world entirely coated with coloured tempered glass.

The Italforni BLXL "THE BULL" Tempered Stained Glass Extra Large Electric Pizza Oven is an incredibly powerful and visually stunning centerpiece for any restaurant or premium catering establishment. Engineered from strong Italian steel and fully coated in coloured shock and high temperature resistant tempered glass, THE BULL is sure to make an impact and add wow factor with it's unique and characterful design.

Capable of keeping up with demand in the busiest restaurants, the BLXL is the largest pizza oven in the range with over one square meter of cooking space - enough for twelve 30cm pizza, nine 35cm pizza or up to five baking trays. The oven features a cooking chamber fully lined with refractory brick containing armoured “hy·pe” heating elements and offers a maximum cooking temperature of 450°C. The oven's outstanding thermal insulation ensures it's external temperature reaches a maximum of just 30°C while in use. Each oven deck has heavy duty counterbalanced doors with tempered double glazed glass windows and is lit internally by high resistance, high capacity halogen lighting. Operation is simple and easy thanks to the unit's intuitive TOUCH control board and digital display.

THE BULL is modular and fully customisable, with the ability to stack up to three pizza oven decks, a choice of proving unit bases or stands and of course the oven's signature hood. The oven comes in black or red as standard, but can be customised with any RAL colour and even personalised with your own unique designs to complement your restaurant's decor. Site surveys are available to help plan your installation - take a look at a kitchen refit project featuring the Italforni BULL Pizza Oven or call our sales team now to find out more.

details: The Bonnet Precijet+ Range of Combination Ovens bring easy, worry free cooking to any professional kitchen. With it's intelligent cooking systems allowing variable control of both the fan systems and power level, along with easy to use touch pad controls which are both incredibly intuitive and ergonomic for the user. The ovens spacious 6 x 1/1 GN Capacity, along with it's enormous bank of programmes to choose from give enough power and versatility for up to 180 covers per day.

Precijet+ Combination ovens also feature beautiful panoramic door windows, allowing for great visibility of the contents while cooking, eliminating the need to open the door. Along side the window, internal LED lighting provides a clear view of the contents as they cook. When it comes to cleaning the oven, the Precijet+ couldn't be simpler, with 3 cleaning cycles to choose, from a 19 minute light cycle, to it's intensive deep cleaning 41 minute cycle. With other combination ovens, a rinse hose is supplied which allows for manual cleaning, the Precijet+ combination ovens have a built in rinse feature, which replaces the need for a spray hose, saving you time in the process.
FastPAD2 - a full colour touch screen interface with images of recipes
CoreControl - Regulates power to suit the load.
USB port for upgrades and recipes.

Its four castor wheels provide additional mobility and flexibility and the two push handles on either side allow for more control and manoeuvrability when having to move the unit longer distances. btsgce240.title: Bradley Smoke Generator with Adaptor
btsgce240.metaDescription: Cater-Kwik are Catering Equipment Suppliers who provide Commercial Dishwashers, Glasswashers, Commercial Microwave, Pizza Oven and Glass washers.
btsgce240.metaKeywords: Bradley, bradley smoker, bradley smokers, home smoker, smoker, BTSGCE240, Bradley BTSGCE240
sellingPoints: Up to 9 hours of continues smoking.
details: The Bradley Smoke Generator allows you to retrofit almost any small structure into a smoke house and consists of two parts, the generator and the adaptor, automatically working for up to 9 hours of smoke without refilling.

The picture shows the Smoke Generator lugged onto the face-plate of the Adaptor, and the adjustable Adaptor Collar can also be seen. When fitted, the wall of the smoke-house structure fits between the faceplate and the collar and is intended to remain in place permanently while the Smoke Generator can be easily attached or removed when not in use.
An ideal structure might be an old chest freezer, stood upright, the lid for the door, with an 11 cm hole in the side for the adaptor.
A blueprint to build your own smokehouse is included with the unit.

db619.title: Lifestyle Big Horn Pellet Grill and Smoker DB619
db619.metaDescription: The Lifestyle Big Horn Pellet Grill and Smoker for home-use. Brought to you by Caterkwik UK. Low price commercial catering products online or by phone!
db619.metaKeywords: grill and smoker, bbq, outdoor cooking, barbeque smoker, Lifestyle BBQ products, LFS256,
sellingPoints: Electronic digital control for precise temperature regulation

details: For the ultimate smoke flavoured steaks, meats and other foods, the electric Lifestyle Big Horn Pellet Grill and Smoker is made for the serious home smoker Barbecuer.

Barbecue enthusiasts will rejoice! This innovative smoker is perfect for home-use, allowing you to enjoy delicious smoky barbecue flavours right in your own backyard. With its versatile capabilities, you can easily grill, bake, smoke or roast all your favourite foods.
Designed purposely to use eco-friendly wood pellets for cooking, the Pellet Grill and Smoker offers an electronic temperature control system that helps ensure precise results every time you use it.

Whether you are looking to slow roast or normal roast, the temperature settings can be adjusted to smoke only or can be set as high as 245°C. The pellet feeder speed adjusts to maintain the grill area temperature that is required. There's also an adjustable warming rack so you can keep food warm without overcooking it. The construction of this smoker is heavy duty too — with stainless steel components designed to withstand even the most extreme weather conditions for long lasting durability.

The UK pellet grilling community is growing rapidly and for good reason. Pellet grills are becoming increasingly popular as they offer a unique cooking experience compared to traditional charcoal and gas grills. Unlike traditional smokers, they require no monitoring or maintenance to keep the heat consistent, making them ideal for home-use.

Pellet grills are great for smoking meats, vegetables and even cheeses right in your backyard without having to tend the fire every few minutes. This makes them easy for all types of users - from novice cooks wanting to learn about smoking food at home, to experienced barbecuers looking for new ways to find grilled flavours. Plus, the food cooked on pellet grills will add an intensely smoky flavour like no other with the opportunity of choosing different flavoured wood pellets, such as apple or oak!
Grilling season just got a lot more exciting with this amazing product from Lifestyle!

details: Bolstering The Falcon Dominator Plus range of Induction cooking equipment is the heavy duty E3917i Solid Top Induction range.

With Induction technology becoming ever more popular due to not only it's incredible energy efficiency but also safety and ease of use, the E3917i hits the mark for chefs and owners looking to add a solid top oven to their kitchen. Traditional gas solid tops give the end user unrivalled flexibility due to the concentric gas burners that radiate heat outwards.. Hotter in the middle, cooler at the edges. Simple stuff.

details: Italforni's ES12-1 Euro Classic Single Deck Electric Pizza Oven is a high performance, heavy duty modular pizza oven manufactured in Pesaro, Italy. The pizza oven features a large aluminum coated steel cooking chamber with refractory baking floor capable of cooking up to twelve 300mm pizza or holding up to four 600 x 400mm baking trays at a time, making it a versatile addition to busy commercial or professional kitchens, restaurants and takeaways.

Heat is generated by upper and lower armoured stainless steel heating elements delivering a maximum cooking temperature of 450°C. The oven is lit internally by high resistance halogen lamps and features a large counter balanced door with tempered glass viewing window. The pizza oven comes fitted with a decorative hood canopy and a choice of mirror stainless steel or rustic style finish, and can be supplied with a range of additional options including open oven stand, hermetic prover compartment, all refractory oven interior and steam injection system.

Which warranty is right for you?

Parts Only – This means only the warranty parts are covered. If the unit should develop a fault, it is the responsibility of the end user to hire an engineer (at their cost) and supply us with a job report to claim the parts, if covered by the warranty the parts are replaced without charge.
Parts and Labour – This means we will send an engineer to site to assess the fault and if covered under the warranty both the cost of the engineer’s labour and parts are non-chargeable.

Removal of the existing unit will happen separately to the delivery of your goods unless previously arranged. Item must be disconnected, emptied, cleaned, and ready for collection. Price is based on like for like in size and larger items may occur additional costs.
Unpack and position is based on clear ground floor access with no obstructions and no refunds are offered if it fails due to access issues.

details: It’s no surprise that the Enders from Lifestyle Kansas Pro 3 Sik Turbo Gas Barbecue is built for commercial use in mind (it’s literally got PRO in its title) but that doesn’t mean it’s not fantastic for home-use cooking too. The Kansas Pro BBQ comes with a huge range of features which every professional or home chef will want to make the most of this summer.

Let’s start with the Heat Range Burner system architecture. This allows the heat distribution to be optimised throughout the cooking area, ensuring consistent cooking wherever you place the food on the grill. The Turbo zone can reach a “searing” temperature of 400°C in rapid time, which is perfect for getting that delicious crust and sear on your steaks. The switch grid element available in the Enders range means it provides enhanced versatile cooking options such as switching in a pan, poultry cooker, pizza stone or sear grate. You can switch it up to cook your way. And, once you’re all done, the Kansas Pro’s Simple Clean System allows for quick removal of all the components in the combustion chamber so you can clean with ease and be prepared for the next batch of BBQ cooking.

The features of the Kansas Pro don’t end there. From the first time you use it, you’ll see it comes with an integrated piezo ignition, which ensures safe and easy ignition without the use of a battery, which means your BBQ will be up to cooking temperature in no time. It’s Double-walled cooking lid with thermometer and large viewing window means you can check on your food without raising the lid, saving you from unwanted heat lose while roasting, smoking or baking your foods. Any food that is ready to serve can sit hygienically on the stainless-steel warming grate, which is easy to wipe down after serving your customers. The additional side burner makes it ideal for keeping side dishes warm in a pot or pan.

So if you’re looking to do some outdoor cooking at your eatery this summer, then this Enders From Lifestyle Kansas Pro 3 Sik Turbo Gas Barbecue will have you ready to go when the Great British BBQ weather arrives.

details: Part of the Buffalo 600 Series, the Buffalo FU291 countertop four pot bain marie is an excellent heavy duty solution for keeping food warm. With capacity fir up to four litres in each pot, the Buffalo 600 series bain marie offers a truly impressive holding capacity, giving you plenty of space for large batches of gravy, beans, soup or other similar liquid foods.

Using wet heat warming, the bain marie uses gentle heat to keep food at the perfect serving temperature. This way, not only does it reduce the chance of food drying out, it also prevents the food from burning to the pots. Operation and maintenance couldn't be easier too - with simple dial temperature control, strong stainless steel construction and the front mounted drain tap, it's simple to keep food warm without a fuss.

As part of the Buffalo 600 Series, this bain marie suites perfectly with other items within the range. Not only does this lead to a smooth, clean work line, it also makes the line safer, with less jagged edges. As a countertop unit, this bain marie can also be mounted on a 600 Series base.

gf14.title: Frymaster GF14 18 Litre Gas Fryer
gf14.metaDescription: Frymaster DEAN Gf14 Gas Fryer with 18L oil capacity, 29.3kW Master Jet burner, Millivolt controls and open-pot design for commercial kitchens.
gf14.metaKeywords: Frymaster GF14, DEAN GF14, GF14 gas Fryer, Frymaster gas fryer, DEAN gas fryer, 20L gas fryer, Commercial gas fryer, ProfessionAL fryer, Open pot fryer,
details: The Frymaster GF14 Gas Fryer is a robust commercial fryer designed for high volume usage in professional catering kitchens. With a generous 18-litre oil capacity and powerful 29.3kW gas burner system, it delivers fast heat recovery and consistent cooking performance during busy service periods. The open-pot design also provides easy access for cleaning and maintenance. The GF14 features Frymaster’s Master Jet burner system, providing efficient and even heat transfer across the frypot. A deep cold zone and forward-sloping frypot base help collect food particles away from the main cooking area, supporting oil quality and simplifying cleaning. The millivolt control system provides reliable temperature management without requiring an electrical connection. Constructed with a stainless steel frypot and door, the GF14 is built for demanding commercial use. Its combination of high output, simple operation and durable construction makes it an excellent choice for kitchens producing high volumes of chips, chicken, fish and other fried food.

details: The Frymaster DEAN GF40 Gas Fryer is a powerful, heavy-duty commercial fryer designed for busy restaurants, takeaways, pubs, hotels and professional catering kitchens. With a generous 22-litre oil capacity, and a high-output 35.8kW gas burner system, it delivers dependable frying performance and consistent heat distribution to support demanding service periods. Its open-pot design provides convenient access to the frypot, helping make everyday cleaning and maintenance easier. The GF40 features Frymasters Master Jet burner system, designed to provide efficient heat transfer throughout the cooking area. A deep cold zone and forward-sloping frypot base help collect food particles and sediment awa from the main cooking area, supporting oil quality and simplifying cleaning. The millivolt temperature temperature control system offers straightforward operation without requiring an electrical connection. Constructed with a stainless steel frypot and door, the GF40 is built to withstand the demands of professional foodservice environments. Its combination of high heat output, generous capacity and practical maintenance features makes it well suited to preparing chips, chicken, fish and other popular fried foods.

This way, there's no need to change containers, so there's no loss of heat and less washing up. Whether you're using a gas hob, electric or induction, the inner pot is suitable for all hob types. As it's a dry heat soup kettle, the Rowlett doesn't use a water bath, and as such doesn't need filling or topping up - just select a temperature using the digital control panel and the Rowlett soup kettle reliably holds temperature for extended periods. details: The Silverlink 600 range is extensive and includes gas and electric light-medium duty prime cooking to make optimum use of available kitchen space.

The Lincat GS9 Silverlink 600 Steel plate Electric Counter-Top Griddle is really versatile and is ideal for the small to medium sized commercial food establishment that requires to save on space. Cafés and small eateries will benefit from the electric counter-top griddle, whether they’re cooking bacon, eggs, burgers or vegetarian alternatives. The two separately controlled heat zones give you further flexibility with your cooking. You can operate either zone independently by the front mounted control for easy and safe use during cooking. The zones also provide a smaller cooking area during quiet periods to be more economical or gives you more versatility when cooking two separate meals simultaneously, for example, cooking your burgers while keeping your veggies at optimum temperature.

This professional counter-top griddle is made with a 12mm thick machined steel plate, which provides even heat distribution and with this commercial kitchen appliance being thermostatically controlled, it gives accurate temperatures during the cooking process for consistent results.

As the Lincat Silverlink 600 Electric Griddle is useable on counter-tops, it means it is suitable for those cafes, small restaurants, kitchens or shops where space saving is vital and don’t have the capacity for a built in or free-standing griddle. The griddle is also ideal for those eateries that like to cook in front of house, allowing the customers to experience the smells and sounds of your cooking while they wait. The professional counter-top single electric griddle is robust, hard working and easy to use. This means it can also withstand the larger busy commercial kitchen environments such as large pubs and restaurants, large hospitals, school canteens, care homes and high volume production kitchens.

When it comes to cleaning, the plate is a flat surface so can easily be scraped and cleaned and as the plate is fully welded into the frame, it also prevent leaks and hygiene standards are improved as places where food and carbon can build up is reduced.

details: Falcon's ScanHeat™ Microwave changes the game in terms of quick self service. Especially in such settings as hospitals, universities or the care home sector. Instead of the traditional time & power input used in commercial microwaves, the IMS-1800S uses a built in barcode reader to analyse the presented meal and cook accordingly. Resulting in perfectly consistent results time after time.

Fully stainless steel chassis, with a large 18 litre capacity, the ScanHeat™ Microwave is ready for the rigors of any commercial kitchen, or even public facing areas such as grab & go venues or deli's. With 11 power levels, 3 cooking stages and 900 barcode menus, the ScanHeat™ has the ultimate in flexibility for customized cooking results.
Inside the oven cavity is a laser scanner, think the barcode scanner at your local supermarket.
Using the included software that is available for both PC & Mac, you can create barcodes for each new menu item, by specifying power level and time.
Once done, simply print the QR code it produces (or take a photo with your phone), and scan this into the Microwave.
From then, you'll be able to scan the barcode of your meal, close the door and let the ScanHeat™ do the rest.

sellingPoints: Save more energy! Up to 40% savings in power consumption.
Cook food up to 35% quicker without compromising on quality.
iVarioBoost - Rapid heat up and consistency, giving you perfect results every time!

details: Rational iVario cooking systems ramp up kitchen productivity to the max. With multiple programs & assistants designed to not only make kitchen life easier, but help you reduce cooking times and energy costs while still maintaining the highest standard of cooking. Equipped with a core probe for precise mid-cooking measurements and built with Rational's intuitive control system, pairing your iVario and your iCombi together as a living breathing kitchen. Whether you are deep frying, or preparing bulk meals, the iVario steps up to replace numerous conventional appliances.

Because flexibility within the modern kitchen is key to unleashing full potential, having the ability to cook multiple dishes at once greatly reduces the need for extra pots, pans and utensils. iZoneControl has the power to divide the pan up to 4 ways, giving you the freedom you need. Whether you need to cook different sizes or completely different dishes either simultaneously or on a time delay. Making use of the included core temperature probe effortlessly allows you to produce consistent, delicious results every time.

iCookingSuite is the iVario's inbuilt assistant. Designed to intelligently monitor and adjust the cooking process to output perfect results time after time. This assistant also learns over time by adapting to your cooking habits and only alerts you when action is needed. iCookingSuite not only monitors temperature and time, the AutoLift function will automatically remove your product from the pan once the cooking cycle is complete. Intelligent automation at it's finest.

iVarioBoost is the turbo of the iVario cooking centre, slow heating response time and inconsistent temperature are the bane of any kitchen. With a combination of ceramic heating elements and fast-response, scratch-resistant pan bases, iVarioBoost pushes power to where it's needed, giving you super fast and accurate heat distribution. iVarioBoost's integrated energy management system still consumes far less than convectional cooking methods. Utilising these power reserves allows you to quickly sear meat without a noticeable temperature drop due to cold products being added.
Multiple cooking functions, allowing the iVario to replace multiple cooking methods.

Constructed from robust stainless steel and featuring a durable heating element, the oven delivers reliable, even heat distribution for dependable results batch after batch. The adjustable 50-250°C temperature range provides the flexibility to cook everything from delicate baked goods to high-temperature roasts, while the 120-minute timer allows for precise, controlled cooking. Inside, the spacious chamber is designed to maximise usable capacity, giving you the room needed for larger dishes and multiple trays. Built for ease of use and everyday reliability, this commercial convection oven is a practical solution for kitchens looking to improve efficiency, optimise output and achieve consistent results every time.

details: The Buffalo JD457 high speed convection oven is the perfect solution for accelerating output without sacrificing quality. Combining powerful forced convection with high-velocity air impingement, the 2.8kW, 21Ltr capacity rapid-cook oven delivers much faster cooking, delivering piping hot food with crisp finishes - and microwave technology. By using convection and impingement, you can easily cook a 30cm frozen pizza in around 2 minutes and 40 seconds, a panini in 1 minute 40 seconds, and a portion of frozen chips in 8 minutes - much faster than traditional ovens. The high-capacity chamber ensures you can cook more at a time, helping you to keep queues moving in cafés, QSRs and hotel breakfast bars.

The intuitive precision control of the Buffalo high speed convection oven helps to drive consistent cooking results, reducing food waste. Its intuitive 2.4" colour LCD display has up to 100 programmable settings, six quick-select buttons and 16 ready-to-use recipes - all reducing training times and ensuring repeatable results across shifts. Wi-Fi cloud connectivity and a USB port simplify menu updates, maintenance and recipe sharing, whilst a five-speed inverter-controlled fan optimises airflow for accurate cooking and superior browning. A holding function keeps the cavity at a temperature between cycles, making sure the oven is ready to cook whenever you are - and if required, the Buffalo oven can also be used as a traditional convection cooker for broader menu flexibility.

Built for busy countertops, the compact footprint features a cool-touch double-glass door and bright internal LED lighting for safe, clear viewing. Rounded interior edges and a residue collection tray speed up cleaning, and the chamber is supplied with a Teflon tray and pizza paddle to get started straight away. A dependable partner for food-to-go areas and convenience operations, delivering high speed and consistent results after service.

details: Designed for busy cafes, restaurants and deli counters, the Rowlett Convection Oven 48Ltr boosts output without taking up valuable space. A 2.6kW bidirectional fan circulates heat in alternating directions for consistent colour on every shelf, whilst rapid 15 minute heat-up and a ready notification keep service on schedule. The intuitive touchscreen with up to 99 minute timer is simple to learn, helping new team members deliver consistent results. With a wide 20-260°C range and a dedicated proving function, the oven handles everything from gentle dough work to high-temperature roasting. Operational flexibility comes as standard. Independent upper and lower elements let the unit work like a compact deck oven for finishing pizzas, browning gratins and perfecting batch bakes. Four shelf positions with two shelves maximise the 48 litre capacity, and an internal light with a double-layer tempered glass door improves visibility and helps retain heat to reduce running costs. For compact, even cooking and dependable operation, the Rowlett Convection Oven is a smart choice for busy prep and service areas.

details: Introducing Joe Jr, the Kamado Joe grill designed to take along. Joe Jr lets you take ceramic grill cooking with you to the ballgame, the beach, the cabin or on the camping trip. It’s portable, it’s compact, and you’ll wonder how you did without it!

The Joe Jr. is not truly a portable grill weighs 68 lbs., but it's not beyond portability. Portable or not, it's ideal for smaller spaces and despite its small sizes has all the features of the Classic Joe.The Joe Jr. does all the cooking tasks of the larger units as well. Baking, Roasting, Grilling, and Smoking all come naturally. And maintaining a consistent temperature as high as 750AF or as low as 225AF is easy on your Joe Jr. Grill.

You can maintain low temperatures for up to 12 hours without adding any 100 Natural Lump Charcoal. This can all be achieved because the wellinsulated ceramic body of a Big Joe standalone grill keeps the heat in the grill. The unique circular shape of the vessel also circulates the heat for more uniform and effective cooking.Compare this with gas grills, that let heat escape and cook largely from below.
* Premium 13.5" Ceramic Grill with Sturdy Stand

What is the difference between Panasonic microwaves with Inverter Technology and conventional microwaves?

Panasonic Microwave Inverter Technology enables your microwave to cook food evenly and cautiously to allow your food to retain almost all the vitamins, minerals, and enzymes that it needs. Thanks to digital power control, meals are never overcooked, nutritionals are very well preserved, and tastes are rich. Intelligent technology is the secret to great results for wholesome, healthy cooking.

Conventional microwaves frequently cycle on and off to retain the power level. Because of that, the food overheats unevenly or is more often than not overcooked. When defrosting, however, this can result in overcooked edges and a center that is too cold.

Inverter Technology in microwaves provides constant consistent control, thus leading to perfectly even cooking results. Microwaves with this constant control consistently retain the ideal power level, which allows food to be properly defrosted and cooked.

details: The Opus 800 range offers a wide choice of gas and electric appliances of high quality, durability & performance.

The Lincat Opus 800 twin tank fryer with pumped filtration is the solution for any commercial kitchen's frying needs! With two independent fryer tanks it provides greater versatility and means you can fry delicious food more accurately at the correct temperatures. The convenient piezo ignition allows for quick lighting and getting the oil to temperature quickly.

When it comes to filtering, the two stage filtration provides extended life to your oil, up to 75%, which means less oil purchases. Plus, the feature of being able to pump hot oil makes this product revolutionary. It means you can filter during service, making it more efficient and in just 5 minutes, your oil is filtered and ready to use again!
The OG8111/OP2 comes with batter plates, baskets, full lids and stainless steel bucket so once it is installed, you’ll have everything you need to get started (except the oil of course).
The Lincat Opus 800 twin tank fryer is stainless steel so easy to clean and, as it comes on castors, it can be manoeuvred easily to get round the back on deep clean days.
The twin fryer is ideal for busier kitchens which require fried foods to be cooked at different temperatures or need the availability of foods to be cooked at different times.
The Lincat Opus 800 tin tank fryer is Ideal for a variety of busy commercial and professional kitchens, whether it's a large pub or a restaurant or smaller takeaway shop.

ps638e.metaDescription: WOW! Conveyor ovens by Middleby Marshall - up to 30% faster than conventional conveyors without compromising on quality.
ps638e.metaKeywords: middleby marshall, conveyor pizza oven, conveyor oven, pizza oven, impingement, wow oven, middleby marshall wow!, Electric pizza oven, commercial pizza oven, takeaway, fast food
sellingPoints: Advanced air delivery system - up to 30% faster then conventional conveyor ovens.
Utilises hot air impingement - perfect results, fast!
Energy Eye - Low power consumption whilst the oven is idle.
details: Middleby Marshall PS638E WOW! Electric Impingement Conveyor Pizza Oven

The Middleby Marshall PS638E WOW! conveyor oven is ideal for any express location looking to increase their throughput whilst saving time and energy in the process. Where WOW! ovens differ from traditional conveyor ovens is with the use of hot air impingement. This forced hot air cooking process results in both the perfectly melted cheese and a crisp tasty crust. Along side this the Middleby Marshall WOW! oven has safety and comfort in mind. Fully constructed from high grade stainless steel and featuring a Cool Skin safety features - Meaning the exterior of the oven chamber never reaches over 120°F (49°C), ensuring safe operation in a busy takeaway or kitchen along with a more comfortable environment for staff.

With more and more appliances opting for greener solutions in a bid to save both energy and the environment, the WOW! Ovens are no different. The patented energy management system (EMS) works to automatically reduce energy consumption while the oven is not in use. So if you've a lull in service, the oven will in effect sit in a standby low power mode - but as soon as any tray or pizza is placed on the belt, You'll be back up to power and ready to cook in 3 seconds.
Impingement PLUS! - Low oven profile with dual air return.
Advanced air delivery system - bakes up to 30% faster than conventional conveyors.
Removable/Cleanable parts (crumb pan, end panels, conveyor belt assembly)
Unique hearth belt provides excellent uniform cooking throughout the base.
Energy Eye" powers down the oven when not in use.
special: This unit requires hard-wiring by a trained engineer.

sch030.metaDescription: Spidocook - CaldoLUX Cook and Hold Oven - SCH 030-GB can cook food up to 120°C and then hold at set temperature.
sellingPoints: Cook and Hold in one Place.
details: CALDOLUX Cook & Hold is a static oven for Low Temp Cooking (max 120°C) and Hold (max 100°C), with full cycle up to max 10+10 hrs. It is designed to produce better food quality and higher yields than normal convection ovens. The Digital Control panel allows full cycle parameters setting. CALDOLUX use allows maximum return on investment, thanks to greater yield, energy efficiency, reduced labour and intelligent use of space.

The COOK function (max 120°C) allows you to cook slowly, gradually enhancing the softness of the meat and reducing weight loss. Thanks to the core probe you can always obtain juicy, evenly cooked food.
The holding function (HOLD) keeps the food inside the cooking chamber at the ideal temperature for its consumption. Dishes are always ready for a fast service, even at peak hours.
Four handles make it very easy to move; in this way you can cook or hold food at the ideal consumption temperature everywhere, also thanks to the included 230V socket.
With CALDOLUX you can build real cooking and holding stations stacking one or more slow-cooking ovens. This solution allows you to cook at the same

time foods that require different cooking times and temperatures. You will also be able to better manage the workload using one or both ovens. The door opening direction can be easily changed at any time.
Easy and always ready to use
The digital panel is designed to handle one complete cooking cycle using all necessary parameters in order to obtain an excellent result.
The core probe recognizes when the cooking ends and lets the oven automatically switch to the holding phase with the previously set temperature
The exhaust slots, both at the front (adjustable) and at the bottom of the chamber (always open), allow to excess humidity to be expelled.

details: The Sammic ST-33 Conveyor toaster is a professional high-output toaster designed for busy commercial kitchens, hotels, breakfast buffets, restaurants, canteens and catering operations. With a powerful 2.8kW heating system and the ability to produce up to 900 slices of toast per hour, it provides a fast and consistent solution for high volume breakfast and foodservice environments. Featuring a 370mm-wide conveyor belt and adjustable conveyor speed, the ST-33 gives operators control over toasting time and browning levels. He continuous-feed design allows bread to be loaded ad toasted efficiently throughout service, while the stainless-steel heating elements provide reliable performance. Its generous 45mm useful product height allows it to accommodate a range of bread products. Built for professional use, the ST-33 combines a durable stainless-steel construction with a compact countertop footprint of just 470mm wide. At 19.5kg, it provides a stable working platform while remaining practical for installation and repositioning. With its high throughput, adjustable operation and robust construction, the Sammic ST-33 is an ideal choice for establishments that need reliable toast production during busy service periods.

details: The Roband ST350A Sycloid Toaster, can toast up to 350 slices of bread per hour, with a 'cool touch' exterior and intelligent, energy efficient design.
The ST350A Sycloid toaster is a 13 amp machine producing up to 350 slices per hour. Optimised to handle bread up to 20mm thick,

The innovative & cleverly designed Sycloid motion indexes the toast through the machine, making it possible to achieve outstanding toasting results. It produces even, golden brown colouration across both sides of the toast.

An automatic power-save mode conserves energy during quiet periods by scaling back energy consumption. The intelligent autosense feature detects when a new slice is placed in the machine & automatically prepares the machine to toast the bread. The heat setting in this mode is balanced & optimised for quick recovery to ensure minimal user impact.
The Sycloid gearbox ensures whisper quiet operation, operating smoothly & consistently.
Diners can easily see when their toast is ready with the cut-away sides of the warm toast chute which is LED illuminated.
A user-friendly & reliable speed controller allows adjustment of the toasting time to account for different types of bread to be toasted.

Featuring robust stainless steel elements, a brushed stainless steel exterior with safe external touch temperatures, a slide-out crumb tray & a hinged top cover allowing easy access to clean the inside. The toast movement racks are also easily removable & are machine washable.
Patron & staff safety is paramount & the Sycloid toaster has been designed with safe external touch temperatures.

Upper And Lower Stainless Steel Armoured Heating Elements.

details: Italforni's TKC2 Twin Deck Electric Pizza Oven is a high performance, high output pizza oven manufactured in Pesaro, Italy. The pizza oven features two large cooking chambers with refractory baking floor, each capable of cooking up to nine 330mm pizza at a time or holding two 600 x 400mm baking trays, making it a versatile addition to busy commercial or professional kitchens, restaurants and takeaways.

Heat is generated by upper and lower armoured stainless steel heating elements delivering a maximum cooking temperature of 450°C. Each oven is lit internally by high resistance halogen lamps and features a large counter balanced door with tempered glass viewing windows. The pizza oven is available in a stainless steel or rustic style finish, and can be supplied with an optional stand or hermetic dough prover compartment.
Independently controlled top & bottom heating elements.
INCLUDES 2 YEARS PARTS, 1 YEAR LABOUR WARRANTY.
Please carefully inspect the pizza stone and remove it from the oven prior to install into the premises.

wg100.metaDescription: The Grelhaco WG Series Portuguese Style Charcoal Chargrill for commercial and professional kitchens, available now from Cater-Kwik.
wg100.metaKeywords: grelhaco charcoal grill, grelhaco wg100, grelhaco chargrill, portuguese charcoal grill, portuguese chargrill, commercial charcoal grill, professional charcoal grill,
details: These Grelhaco chargrills come in two designs - one specifically designed for chicken, these models have a space of 240mm between the charcoal bed and the cooking grates or the meat/fish version which have a 120mm space. The higher spacing for the chicken allows cooking to be done with less "flare up" as the fat burning is further away than in the meat version.
* Two designs available - for Chicken or Meat/Fish - 240mm space between grate and charcoal base for chicken model, 120mm for meat/fish model.
* Inner cooking chamber is lined with high density firebricks - retains heat and long lasting
* Outer wall are insulated with mineral wool
* Supplied with removable ash collection pan
* Supplied with mobile base unit with charcoal storage drawer

Please note all charcoal chargills must be sited under an extraction canopy , ideally dedicated to the charcoal grill, with a large enough extract capacity to fully remove all fumes exhausted from the oven to the outside atmosphere. Specialist suppliers can supply an extraction system on request with activated carbon filters and odor neutralizers - please contact office for details.
